notes:
Exclamation marks are exclamation marks again. Comic lettering is set in capitals, where ! and I are the same upright stroke — so "GOLD!" was being read aloud as "Goldi" and "WOW!" as "Wowi". The word came out wrong and the line lost the emphasis it was drawn with. Both are fixed, carefully: a name like Kaori or Naomi is never touched, because the repair only fires when removing the letter leaves a real word.

The Bilibili Comics watermark burned into the artwork is no longer read out. Tales of Demons and Gods was announcing it on most pages.

Also in this update, from v2.55: lettering drawn as a noise — KRAAAA, DOKI DOKI — now has a voice of its own, the deepest one, read slowly. These used to be skipped in silence. Settings › Voice has a switch for it. Fair warning: on Infinite Gacha and Solo Leveling it rarely fires yet, because the recogniser still can't read stylised lettering.

Chapters you've already read will re-read their pages once to pick this up.
